items.title: Book Signing at Prologue Bookstore
items.location: Prologue Bookstore, 126 S Wood St, Neosho, MO 64850
items.summary: Meet Anthony Angel and get signed copies of Moon Gun Sam: The Dolphin — Vow and The Dolphin — Ember.
items.recap: Thank you to everyone who came out to Prologue Bookstore in Neosho, and to Prologue for hosting us! It was a joy to meet you and sign books. See you at the next one.

items.title: Psalms of Chaos announcement trailer
items.summary: The announcement trailer for Book Three, Psalms of Chaos, with an original score by Elijah Siegler, is planned for Christmas. Pod members hear about it first.
